Container.Name: cef-tracker
Container.Overview: CEF Tracker — closed-end fund discount-to-NAV surveillance (BUY/WATCH/HOLD/SELL/AVOID signals) over ~367 CEFs, with a CEFConnect/FRED/sponsor data pipeline (APScheduler). Flask/SQLite, single gunicorn worker. The only required persistent volume is /data (the SQLite DB) on the appdata pool. Set FLASK_SECRET_KEY (required; without it the container starts but stays UNHEALTHY, serving only a 503 that names the missing variable). Google/Microsoft OAuth are optional. FRED key, Anthropic key and ntfy remain managed in-app under Admin → System Settings. SMTP infra creds (host/port/user/password/from) now come from kw-common's fleet-shared configs/alerting.env instead — set the Shared alerting root below to enable outbound email; it is OPTIONAL, and this container runs fine with it unset (email is simply disabled, exactly as an unset smtp_host meant before). See github.com/texasdaddy/kw-common/blob/main/docs/alerting-setup.md.
Container.Description: CEF Tracker — closed-end fund discount-to-NAV tracker (Flask/SQLite).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite DB directory - the only persistent volume. REQUIRED - an absolute path on a POOL.

Config.Name: FLASK_SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Flask session signing key. REQUIRED — if missing or blank the container still starts, but every page returns 503 and Docker reports it UNHEALTHY until you set it. Generate: python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))"

Config.Name: APP_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Public base URL of THIS deployment; used to build the OAuth redirect URIs, so it must match what is registered with Google/Microsoft. REQUIRED for OAuth sign-in — the image carries no default.

Config.Name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Google OAuth client ID (optional; blank disables Google sign-in).

Config.Name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Microsoft OAuth client ID (optional; blank disables Microsoft sign-in).

Config.Name: DB_PATH
Config.Description: SQLite database file, INSIDE the container. Leave as the default unless you know why you are changing it — it must sit under the /data mount above or the database will not survive a restart. Blank is treated as the default.

Config.Name: FLASK_ENV
Config.Description: production (default) or development. Only set development for debugging — it enables debug mode. Blank is treated as production.

Config.Name: Shared alerting root
Config.Description: OPTIONAL. The host directory holding configs/alerting.env - the ONE file every Keystone container reads its SMTP settings from. Mounted READ-ONLY: this container never writes to it. Leave blank to run with outbound email disabled (job-error alert emails and invitation emails will not send; the app itself is unaffected). Full instructions: github.com/texasdaddy/kw-common/blob/main/docs/alerting-setup.md

Config.Name: SHARED_ROOT
Config.Description: The CONTAINER path the shared alerting root above is mounted at. Leave it alone if you set the Shared alerting root mapping above - it must match that mapping's container-side target. Leave BOTH blank to disable outbound email.
